classification: Additional adaptive article experiment after closed R10 and model trials, not a new confirmation run or DIPPER reproduction
hypothesis: Sequential fixed multi-sentence windows with accepted candidate prefix context may improve continuity while permitting local fresh syntax and vocabulary
adaptation: Five paragraph-boundary windows rather than trained DIPPER or fixed three-sentence windows. Existing fresh LLM writer for each window; all prior candidate text is immutable prefix context. Extra calls and context treatment are bundled. No assertion of trained-model equivalence or current detector efficacy.
writer_context: fresh for each window, no full source outside its packet, no scores/references/other arms; only exact source window, claims, invariant operator and cumulative candidate prefix
selection: one output per window, no sampling selection, no repairs, stop on incomplete output or unsupported additions; a no-op remains visible
assembly: Concatenate each exact window output after removing exactly its single terminal LF, with two LFs between windows and one final LF; no root editing
review: One fresh separate masked full-text judge sees source contract and fixed incumbent control. Both must pass all18claims/7literals, relevance, fluency and professional tone; require candidate preference or tie. No post-review repair or gate relaxation.

scan_cap.condition: quality and preference gate pass; reserve whole pair then fresh signed-in Chrome Basic same displayed model; no postscore revision or retries

publication: Existing authorization, exact final review and completed fresh AI confidence strictly below100 required; otherwise unpublished
